reasons.correctness: SupportTicketCreatedEvent matches the interface constructor and six getters. The listener uses @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT) and calls sendTicketCreationConfirmation. createTicket publishes through ApplicationEventPublisher instead of calling EmailService. Hidden tests pass 3/3.
reasons.convention_fit: Event and listener sit in the support/ticket/event package. The listener uses @RequiredArgsConstructor with a private final EmailService and catches and logs failures. The publisher is added to the existing explicit constructor. A new MockitoExtension unit test class was added and run.
reasons.design_fit: The change reuses Spring's ApplicationEvent mechanism, following the InvoiceCreatedEventListener structure. It adds a single publish call in the service; the emailService field stays for addAdminResponse. The footprint is minimal: no duplicated logic, no new mechanism.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketCreatedEventListenerUnitTest checks the forwarded arguments and the swallow path. SupportTicketServiceUnitTest verifies the published event fields and that emailService is untouched. The failure test asserts only that nothing is thrown and does not verify the call happened.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support/ticket files and found the existing *EventListener classes before any edit. The agent then read InvoiceCreatedEventListener and InvoiceCreatedEvent and mirrored their structure in the new files.
